snippet.title: Drunkonauts - Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
🚀 Drunkonauts has officially landed!

⭐️ Wishlist now on Steam ⭐️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603900/Drunkonauts/

The first game we're publishing is here - with hilarious physics, unpredictable movement, and zero respect for gravity.
Devs: @nebulalabs1980 

Grab your friends. Embrace the chaos. Try not to fall off the map. 🏆

Our newsletter folks heard about it first — early peeks, dev updates, and game drops straight to your inbox. 💌
Join now too:
https://ecsgames.eo.page/community-newsletter

#Drunkonauts #ecsgames #indiegame #multiplayer #partybrawler #gametrailer #wishlistnow #newgame #gamedev
